coverage_notes: The priorities pair client-reported operational capacity with buyer-decision education. The reserve adds an unresolved venue investigation from a different conversation rather than another positive-result claim.
a05 and a06 overlap in the purchase-research survey material. Their positioning and workflow distinctions are meaningful, but both are unnecessary in this small slate.
The selected interpretation in a05 is not a completed positioning solution; the reported investigation in a09 is not a successful fix. Neither requires an invented outcome to remain useful.
This experiment recommends two priorities and one reserve within the project's 1–3 Reel weekly planning range; it does not establish a new production cap or posting schedule.
